description: After a years-long process of doctor’s visits and misdiagnoses, I was diagnosed with Alzheimer’s at the age of 53. As a widowed mother of three teens, this was a devastating development. We met with Sen. Susan Collins, who has a clear vision for how Alzheimer’s prevention, detection, treatment, and care can continue to be improved with […]
